title: subdomain node
description:
A partition of the problem space, classified where careful modelling is worth its cost. It is itself a scope, so it belongs to none and declares no boundary.

The classification is not a label. `core` is where this business differs from its competitors; `supporting` is necessary and specific to it but not differentiating; `generic` is a solved problem where the right answer is usually to buy rather than to model. A request that treats everything as core has not been analysed.
x-alternation: Every field this kind requires is alternated separately against a gap naming that field, so a gap about one fact never excuses the absence of another. The shape is stated once in `../tables/invariants.json#/x-gap-alternation`. A prohibition is not excused: a gap says a fact is absent and cannot make a forbidden field allowed.
